season.goal: Build consistent, durable fitness for a sub-2:00 half marathon on 2027-05-23, then develop cycling endurance and gravel-specific strength for a 3:10 or faster 100 km gravel race with 1170 m climbing on 2027-08-22.
season.introduction: Welcome aboard. I’m your coach for the season, and I’m looking forward to helping you build back steadily and turn your past experience into strong, consistent racing.

blocks.name: Gravel-specific build

blocks.name: Gravel taper and recovery
blocks.focus: Reduce volume while keeping brief race-specific efforts; race on 2027-08-22, then recover through the season end.

season.rationale: The half marathon is complete, and your recent easy rides show a sensible return to training. The August gravel race now drives the work: build regular cycling and aerobic durability first, then add longer rides and race-specific climbing efforts. Your training history supports a gradual, consistent progression rather than trying to fill every available hour at once.
